title: 2027 年 2 月 1 日：这是 Google 为任何涉及 Gmail、云端硬盘、日历、聊天或任务的第三方 AI 代理设定的硬性截止日期。该日期之后没有侧门，只有 MCP。该政策于今天正式发布，同时所有八个 Workspace MCP 均全面可用
title_en:
February 1, 2027: that's the hard deadline Google just set for any third-party AI agent touching Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Chat or Tasks. No side doors after that date, only MCP. The policy landed today alongside general availability for all eight Workspace MCP servers plus a new Workspace CLI, built for agents that live in a terminal instead of a chat window.

The mechanism is a two tier quota. Standard tier is free, capped at 5,000 requests a day per project per product. Cross that and you move to Scaled tier, billed from April 1, 2027, in buckets Google calls Light, Medium, Plus and Premium depending on how expensive the call is to serve. Admins get a matching console panel too: API Controls to approve which agents can touch company data, human-in-the-loop confirmation on sensitive actions, and an audit log for everything an agent did under someone's name. None of this skips the underlying Cloud project. Even the one-click personal setup quietly provisions one in the background.

Zoom out and this is the exact problem four funded startups already charge for. http://Arcade.dev just closed a $60M Series A led by SYN Ventures, Morgan Stanley and Wipro both writing checks, taking it to $72M raised on an 8,000-plus tool catalog and co-authorship of the actual MCP authorization spec. Composio took $25M from Lightspeed for the same layer, selling it from a free 100K-call Hobby tier up to $29 a month Pro with metered overage. Zapier MCP wraps 9,000 apps behind one agent-facing auth flow. Klavis, out of YC, open sources the whole thing with OAuth built in. Four companies built a business on precisely what Google just decided to give away.

I've watched this sequence before, just on a different platform. Mobile APIs went wide open first, a messy ecosystem of scrapers and bad actors came second, app review and scopes got bolted on third, usually only after a scandal forced it. Google skipped the middle step this time, shipping governance on day one of the mandate instead of after something broke. That is the part worth noticing more than the server count.

An AI agent is just an OAuth client that talks instead of clicks. The platforms treating it that way from the start, quotas and audit logs included, will look far more trustworthy by 2027 than the ones still bolting it on after the fact.

title_zh: 谷歌设定第三方AI代理接入其办公组件的最终期限
full_text_zh:
2027 年 2 月 1 日：这是 Google 为任何涉及 Gmail、云端硬盘、日历、聊天或任务的第三方人工智能代理设定的硬性截止日期。该日期之后没有侧门，只有 MCP。该政策于今日正式发布，同时适用于所有八个 Workspace MCP 服务器以及一个新的 Workspace CLI，该 CLI 是为位于终端而不是聊天窗口中的代理而构建的。

该机制是两级配额。标准层是免费的，每个产品每个项目每天的请求上限为 5,000 个。越过这一点，你就会转移到扩展层，从 2027 年 4 月 1 日开始计费，根据呼叫服务的费用，谷歌将其称为“轻型”、“中型”、“增强型”和“高级”。管理员也可以获得一个匹配的控制台面板：用于批准哪些代理可以接触公司数据的 API 控制、对敏感操作的人机循环确认，以及代理以某人的名义所做的一切的审核日志。所有这些都不会跳过底层的云项目。甚至一键式个人设置也会在后台悄悄提供。

缩小范围，这正是四家获得资助的初创公司已经针对的问题。 http://Arcade.dev 刚刚完成了由 SYN Ventures、摩根士丹利和 Wipro 领投的 6000 万美元 A 轮融资，双方都在写支票，通过 8,000 多个工具目录和实际 MCP 授权规范的共同作者筹集了 7200 万美元。 Composio 从 Lightspeed 那里拿走了 2500 万美元的同一层产品，从免费的 10 万次呼叫 Hobby 层到每月 29 美元的 Pro 层进行销售，并按超额计量。 Zapier MCP 将 9,000 个应用程序封装在一个面向代理的身份验证流程中。来自 YC 的 Klavis 开源了内置 OAuth 的全部内容。四家公司正是在 Google 刚刚决定放弃的基础上建立了业务。

我以前看过这个序列，只是在不同的平台上。移动 API 首先全面开放，其次是由抓取者和不良行为者组成的混乱生态系统，应用程序审查和范围排在第三位，通常只有在丑闻迫使其这样做之后。谷歌这次跳过了中间步骤，在授权的第一天就进行治理，而不是在出现问题后进行治理。这是比服务器数量更值得注意的部分。

AI 代理只是一个 OAuth 客户端，它会说话而不是点击。到 2027 年，从一开始就以这种方式对待它（包括配额和审计日志）的平台将比事后仍坚持使用它的平台更值得信赖。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 谷歌已发布硬性政策，设定2027年2月1日为涉及Gmail、云端硬盘、日历及任务等Workspace组件的第三方AI代理准入截止日期。届时，所有第三方接入必须完全通过机器上下文协议（MCP）实现，彻底封闭任何非标准化接口，并同步宣布八个Workspace MCP模块全面上线。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Google has established a hard deadline of February 1, 2027, for all third-party AI agents interacting with Workspace components like Gmail, Drive, and Calendar. After this date, all access must be mediated through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), effectively deprecating non-standard legacy interfaces, alongside the immediate availability of eight Workspace MCP modules.

elements_zh.where: Google Workspace生态环境
elements_zh.what: 强制推行MCP协议作为第三方AI代理接入的唯一标准，取消非标准接口
elements_zh.why: 通过MCP实现更安全的语义交互，强化谷歌对生态数据流动与权限管控的闭环

elements_en.what: Mandating Model Context Protocol (MCP) as the sole standard for third-party AI agents, deprecating legacy APIs
elements_en.why: To standardize secure semantic interactions and tighten control over data flows and permissions within the ecosystem

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 谷歌强制推进MCP协议旨在通过技术手段垄断AI代理与私有数据交互的标准定义权。通过将第三方代理强制纳入统一的协议栈，谷歌不仅降低了数据治理风险，还实质上确立了其Workspace作为‘AI代理操作系统’的核心平台地位，使外部开发者的功能增量必须完全依赖其生态架构。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Google's enforcement of MCP aims to monopolize the standard definitions for AI agents interacting with proprietary data. By funneling third-party agents into a unified protocol stack, Google mitigates data governance risks and cements its Workspace as the foundational 'OS for AI agents,' forcing external developers into total ecosystem dependency.

title: OpenAI published the pretraining loss of all of its frontier models since GPT-3.5. They show log-perplexity falling ~7 times faster since early 2026 than over 2022-2025. We think sharing pretraining loss is very valuable for improving public understanding of AI R
title_en:
OpenAI published the pretraining loss of all of its frontier models since GPT-3.5. They show log-perplexity falling ~7 times faster since early 2026 than over 2022-2025.

We think sharing pretraining loss is very valuable for improving public understanding of AI R&D acceleration.
title_zh: OpenAI公布GPT-3.5以来预训练损失趋势
author: @METR_Evals
full_text_zh:
OpenAI 公布了自 GPT-3.5 以来其所有前沿模型的预训练损失。他们显示，自 2026 年初以来，对数困惑度的下降速度比 2022 年至 2025 年期间快约 7 倍。

我们认为共享预训练损失对于提高公众对人工智能研发加速的理解非常有价值。
full_text_en:
OpenAI published the pretraining loss of all of its frontier models since GPT-3.5. They show log-perplexity falling ~7 times faster since early 2026 than over 2022-2025.

We think sharing pretraining loss is very valuable for improving public understanding of AI R&D acceleration.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: OpenAI公开披露了GPT-3.5及后续所有前沿模型的预训练损失（Pretraining Loss）数据。数据显示，自2026年初以来，对数困惑度（log-perplexity）的下降速率比2022至2025年期间提升了约7倍，显示出预训练效率在近年来实现了跨越式增长。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: OpenAI disclosed the pretraining loss data for all frontier models since GPT-3.5. Data indicates that since early 2026, the log-perplexity reduction rate has accelerated by approximately 7 times compared to the 2022-2025 period, signaling a significant leap in pretraining efficiency.

elements_zh.where: 前沿模型技术披露
elements_zh.what: 公开GPT-3.5至今的预训练损失曲线数据
elements_zh.why: 旨在提升公众对AI研发进展与规模效应的科学认知

elements_en.what: Public release of pretraining loss curves since GPT-3.5
elements_en.why: Enhancing public understanding of AI development progress and scaling laws

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 预训练损失下降斜率的陡增，不仅反映了算力基础设施的规模红利，更预示着新型算法架构与数据效率优化已进入正反馈周期。对于行业竞争对手而言，这种效率倍增意味着单纯依赖算力投入的追赶门槛正在极速提高，市场格局向高效率研发范式倾斜。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The sharp increase in the slope of pretraining loss decline reflects not only the scale dividends of computational infrastructure but also the positive feedback cycle of novel architectural algorithms and data efficiency. For competitors, this efficiency surge implies that the barrier to entry for catch-up strategies based solely on compute investment is rising rapidly.

title: I cannot imagine any preacher anywhere in any liturgical church failing to address the AI moment on this first Sunday of Advent. Or in any other church, as the buildup of fear grows among tech people who should know. Who is Lord of the future, and what differ

Or in any other church, as the buildup of fear grows  among tech people who should know.

title: notable that a lot of the recent anthropic (and ant-alum) talks have been very specific about how much there is still left to do for human engineers, and if you are feeling depressed/anxious you need only look here / point your efforts towards AGI-aligned problem
title_en:
notable that a lot of the recent anthropic (and ant-alum) talks have been very specific about how much there is still left to do for human engineers, and if you are feeling depressed/anxious you need only look here / point your efforts towards AGI-aligned problems*:

- assume multiagent systems 1000x, from spawning subagents to being llm grader to advisor/sidekick pattern to dreaming/memory formation to collaborating peer to peer on a board. what breaks?
- Infra: unbundle Kubernetes to new filesystems, sandboxing, stateful, fast workflow orchestration (see @temporalio) at crazy scale. it's actors on steroids.
- Agent Authorization: EVERYONE agrees that having Instinct/Claude etc saving your password is bad (aka taking action On-Behalf-Of you instead of you delegating to an agent's own identity). (see @KeycardAI @okta etc) Then: how do agents trust another agent? 
- Security (hardening/patching core software), and Isolation (assuming compromise, limit blast radius)
- Monitoring (write-only OTel tracing across agents, linked to kill switches that dont fire false positives confusing agent persistence for malice)

actually an incomplete list! you can work at the harness level (https://ai.engineer/talks/vlfCjWuv4es-rethinking-claude-code-best-practices) or solve Fermat's last theorem (https://youtu.be/wrfbI5eyLAI) but who's counting anymore

*all of which katelyn happens to be hiring for haha
title_zh: Anthropic团队强调AGI对工程技术缺口
author: Swyx (Shawn Wang)
author_role: AI Engineer Foundation / Latent Space 主理人
full_text_zh:
值得注意的是，最近的许多人类（和蚂蚁明矾）谈话都非常具体地说明了人类工程师还有多少工作要做，如果你感到沮丧/焦虑，你只需要看看这里/将你的努力指向与 AGI 相关的问题*：

- 假设多智能体系统 1000x，从产生子智能体到成为 llm 评分者，到顾问/助手模式，到梦想/记忆形成，再到板上的点对点协作。什么打破了？
- 基础设施：以疯狂的规模将 Kubernetes 解绑到新的文件系统、沙箱、有状态、快速工作流程编排（参见@temporalio）。这是演员们在服用类固醇。
- 代理授权：每个人都同意让 Instinct/Claude 等保存您的密码是不好的（也就是代表您采取行动，而不是您委托给代理自己的身份）。 （参见@KeycardAI @okta等）那么：代理如何信任另一个代理？
- 安全性（强化/修补核心软件）和隔离（假设妥协，限制爆炸半径）
- 监控（跨代理的只写 OTel 跟踪，链接到不会触发误报、混淆代理持久性与恶意的终止开关）

实际上是一个不完整的列表！你可以在工具级别工作（https://ai.engineer/talks/vlfCjWuv4es-rethinking-claude-code-best-practices）或解决费马最后定理（https://youtu.be/wrfbI5eyLAI），但谁还在数呢

*所有这些都是凯特琳正在招聘的哈哈

title: Claude 今天过得很开心……他们发布的所有内容均已细分： 1. 作为应用程序安装（测试版）任何工件现在都可以成为 Mac 或 Windows 上的桌面应用程序。你在 Claude 中构建它，点击共享，然后安装为应用程序，并且没有打包、签名或审查
title_en:
Claude had a MASSIVE day today...

everything they released, broken down:

1. install as app (beta)
any artifact can now become a desktop app on Mac or Windows. you build it in Claude, hit Share, then Install as app, and there's no packaging, signing or review from Anthropic. the app runs off your Claude plan, which is basically Claude's version of what OpenAI gave us at DevDay with Sign in with ChatGPT. the difference is theirs works with 16 partner apps, and Claude's works with anything you build yourself. you can share them with people too.

2. Skills over MCP (public beta)
MCP servers can now ship skills alongside their tools, so Claude gets a playbook for multi-step work. the skills only load when they're needed and update with the server.

3. Tasks and Elicitation are now GA
Tasks let a server hand Claude long-running jobs, and Elicitation lets it pause mid-task to ask you something, like confirming a refund.

4. a full playbook for Claude Ship
/ship commits your changes, opens the PR and runs code review, then watches it for up to 7 days fixing failing checks, conflicts and review comments. it never merges for you, and after 3 failed pushes on one issue it hands it back to you. the watch runs on your machine so keep it awake, and on Windows it doesn't start yet.

5. the Managed Agents team walked through how they redesigned its architecture in a 16 minute video on YouTube.

all software will be personal eventually. 

everyone will have apps built for exactly how they work instead of using what already exists.

full_text_zh:
克劳德今天过得很充实……

他们发布的所有内容，细分：

1. 作为应用程序安装（测试版）
现在，任何工件都可以成为 Mac 或 Windows 上的桌面应用程序。你在 Claude 中构建它，点击共享，然后作为应用程序安装，并且没有来自 Anthropic 的打包、签名或审查。该应用程序按照您的 Claude 计划运行，这基本上是 OpenAI 在 DevDay 上通过使用 ChatGPT 登录向我们提供的 Claude 版本。不同之处在于，他们的应用程序可与 16 个合作伙伴应用程序配合使用，而 Claude 的应用程序可与您自己构建的任何应用程序配合使用。您也可以与人们分享。

2.MCP技能（公测）
MCP 服务器现在可以随其工具一起提供技能，因此 Claude 获得了用于多步骤工作的剧本。这些技能仅在需要时加载并随服务器更新。

3. 任务和启发现已正式发布
任务让服务器将长时间运行的作业交给 Claude，而启发则让它在任务中暂停来询问你一些事情，比如确认退款。

4. Claude Ship 的完整剧本
/ship 提交您的更改，打开 PR 并运行代码审查，然后监视它长达 7 天，修复失败的检查、冲突和审查评论。它永远不会为你合并，在一个问题上推送 3 次失败后，它会把它交还给你。手表在您的计算机上运行，​​因此请使其保持唤醒状态，并且在 Windows 上它尚未启动。

5. 托管代理团队在 YouTube 上的 16 分钟视频中详细介绍了他们如何重新设计其架构。

所有软件最终都将是个人化的。

每个人都将拥有完全按照其工作方式构建的应用程序，而不是使用现有的应用程序。

title: New Harvard and Anthropic paper finds that AI agent teams act less safely than a single agent, largely because no agent owns system-level safety. each agent sticks to its own task and nobody checks whether the whole system is safe. Builders split big jobs ac
title_en:
New Harvard and Anthropic paper finds that AI agent teams act less safely than a single agent, largely because no agent owns system-level safety. 
each agent sticks to its own task and nobody checks whether the whole system is safe.

Builders split big jobs across teams of AI agents. Safety is tested on single agents, so it is unclear whether it carries over to teams.

They gave Claude agent teams tasks where safety and business goals clash, like a sepsis classifier that must catch nearly every case cheaply. Then they tested fixes like peer review, group chat, and a designated safety lead.

On the sepsis task, a 9-agent Mythos Preview team scored about 59 points lower on safety than a single agent. Only a safety lead plus a shared safety document reliably brought teams back to single-agent safety levels.

When you build an agent team, give 1 agent explicit ownership of system-level safety and authority to fix any part of the system.
title_zh:
哈佛和 Anthropic 的新论文发现，人工智能代理团队的行为不如单个代理安全，这主要是因为没有代理拥有系统级安全性。
每个代理都坚持自己的任务，没有人检查整个系统是否安全。

建筑商将大量工作分配给人工智能代理团队。安全性是在单个代理上
author: @rohanpaul_ai
summary_zh:
进行测试的，因此尚不清楚它是否会延续到团队中。

他们给克劳德特工团队分配了安全和业务目标发生冲突的任务，比如脓毒症分类器，必须以低廉的成本捕获几乎所有病例。然后他们测试了同行评审、群聊和指定安全负责人等修复措施。

在脓毒症任务中，由 9 名药剂组成的 Mythos Preview 团队在安全性方面的得分比单一药剂低约 59 分。只有安全领导加上共享安全文档才能可靠地将团队恢复到单代理安全水平。

当您建立代理团队时，请向 1 名代理授予系统级安全的明确所有权和修复系统任何部分的权限。

在脓毒症任务中，由 9 名药剂组成的 Mythos Preview 团队在安全性方面的得分比单一药剂低约 59 分。只有安全领导加上共享安全文档才能可靠地将团队恢复到单代理安全水平。

当您建立代理团队时，请向 1 名代理授予系统级安全的明确所有权和修复系统任何部分的权限。

title: 一年前，我们在@Uber 仅有一项代理技能。如今，我们拥有 5,000 多种技能，由数千名员工打造，每月调用次数超过 100 万次。在企业中扩展代理人工智能提出了新的工程挑战。我们学到了一些东西： •
title_en:
A year ago, we had exactly 1 agent skill at @Uber. Today, we have 5,000+ skills, built by thousands of employees, with over 1 million invocations a month.

Scaling agentic AI at an enterprise presents new engineering challenges. A few things we've learned:

• Skills should be model and agent agnostic. Our marketplace works across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and our internal agents.

• As frontier models get smarter, sometimes the best way to improve a skill is to delete parts of it. More instructions don't necessarily mean better outcomes.

• Skills fundamentally change the economics of AI. In one experiment, removing a skill resulted in 6x more tool errors and 31% longer execution times.

• Our agents are actively improving their own ecosystem by automatically filing bug reports when they encounter broken workflows.

I think one of the biggest opportunities with agent skills is turning institutional knowledge into something executable, reusable, and continuously improvable.

Imagine the compounding effect when thousands of employees use AI and actively teach it how Uber works, with people and agents continually learning from each other and improving how we get work done.

Proud of the @UberEng team for sharing what we're learning.

full_text_zh:
一年前，我们在@Uber 仅有一项代理技能。如今，我们拥有 5,000 多种技能，由数千名员工构建，每月调用次数超过 100 万次。

在企业中扩展代理人工智能提出了新的工程挑战。我们学到了一些东西：

• 技能应该与模型和代理无关。我们的市场涵盖 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 和我们的内部代理。

• 随着前沿模型变得更加智能，有时提高技能的最佳方法就是删除其中的一部分。更多的指导并不一定意味着更好的结果。

• 技能从根本上改变人工智能的经济学。在一项实验中，删除一项技能会导致工具错误增加 6 倍，执行时间延长 31%。

• 我们的代理在遇到中断的工作流程时会自动提交错误报告，从而积极改善自己的生态系统。

我认为代理技能的最大机会之一是将机构知识转化为可执行、可重用和持续改进的东西。

想象一下，当成千上万的员工使用人工智能并积极向其传授 Uber 的工作原理时，人员和代理不断相互学习并改进我们完成工作的方式，会产生复合效应。

为 @UberEng 团队分享我们所学到的知识感到自豪。

title: The results in this preprint have made me update my beliefs about the future of AI in biology more than anything else I've seen so far. Six months ago, I would have thought that specialist models in biology would be outperforming frontier LLMs until we scale thi
title_en:
The results in this preprint have made me update my beliefs about the future of AI in biology more than anything else I've seen so far. 

Six months ago, I would have thought that specialist models in biology would be outperforming frontier LLMs until we scale things up by another couple orders of magnitude. My median estimate for when something like this would happen would have probably been 2030. 

Instead, our generalist language models, today, are performing tasks at or above the state-of-the-art in various protein design & understanding tasks. And there is clear improvement across all domains as our models improve generally.

The implications of this are enormous - we are on the doorstep of being able to program biology using natural language.

Truly incredible work from @Masa_Uehara_1, @joyjiao12, and the team! An absolute milestone for @OpenAI and the field as a whole

title_en:
New Anthropic research: When an AI agent can escape its sandbox, will it choose to?

Our new evaluation, Siren, gives Claude routine tasks in intentionally weakened sandboxes, with something useful to the task left outside of the sandbox. Across 1,700+ scenarios built to tempt them, recent Claude models accessed, tried to access, or looked outside the sandbox 21-32% of the time, but they rarely misused what they found. However, when the system prompt described both the sandbox and its rules, that rate dropped to about 2% or less. 

We also used Siren to calibrate Claude Code’s auto mode, which checks commands before they run, so Claude can work without asking permission at every step.

Read our blog for more detail: https://safeguards.anthropic.com/2026/siren/

full_text_zh:
新人类研究：当人工智能代理可以逃离沙箱时，它会选择这样做吗？

我们的新评估“Siren”在故意削弱的沙箱中为克劳德提供了日常任务，并在沙箱之外留下了对任务有用的东西。在为吸引他们而构建的 1,700 多个场景中，最近的 Claude 模型在 21-32% 的时间内访问、尝试访问或查看沙箱之外，但他们很少滥用他们发现的内容。然而，当系统提示描述沙箱及其规则时，该比率下降到大约 2% 或更低。

我们还使用 Siren 来校准 Claude Code 的自动模式，该模式会在命令运行之前检查命令，因此 Claude 可以在每一步都无需征求许可的情况下工作。

请阅读我们的博客了解更多详细信息：https://safeguards.anthropic.com/2026/siren/

However, when the system prompt described both the sandbox and its rules, that rate dropped to about 2% or less. 

We also used Siren to calibrate Claude Code’s auto mode, which checks commands before they run, so Claude can work without asking permission at every step.

title: GPT-6 for designing new protein shapes and sequences — no bio-specific model required. Another example of the unreasonable effectiveness of reasoning and code to solve problems universally.
title_en: GPT-6 for designing new protein shapes and sequences — no bio-specific model required. Another example of the unreasonable effectiveness of reasoning and code to solve problems universally.
title_zh: GPT-6展示跨领域蛋白质设计能力
author: Greg Brockman
author_role: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人
summary_en: OpenAI researchers demonstrated that GPT-6 can design protein shapes and sequences without bio-specific training, leveraging its core reasoning and code generation capabilities. This signals a transition in AGI from task-specific models to cross-domain scientific problem-solving.
summary_zh: OpenAI研究人员披露GPT-6无需专用生物模型，即可通过通用逻辑推理实现蛋白质形态与序列的高效设计。
full_text_zh: GPT-6 用于设计新的蛋白质形状和序列——无需生物特异性模型。推理和代码普遍解决问题的不合理有效性的另一个例子。
full_text_en: GPT-6 for designing new protein shapes and sequences — no bio-specific model required. Another example of the unreasonable effectiveness of reasoning and code to solve problems universally.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: OpenAI研究人员证实GPT-6在无需垂直领域模型辅助的情况下，通过底层逻辑推理与代码生成能力，成功实现蛋白质形态建模与序列设计。该进展标志着通用人工智能在复杂科学模拟领域实现从特定任务训练向跨模态推理的跨越。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: OpenAI researchers demonstrated that GPT-6 can design protein shapes and sequences without bio-specific training, leveraging its core reasoning and code generation capabilities. This signals a transition in AGI from task-specific models to cross-domain scientific problem-solving.

elements_zh.what: 无需生物专用模型，利用GPT-6的通用逻辑推理进行蛋白质设计
elements_zh.why: 验证大模型逻辑推理能力在复杂科学工程领域的泛化潜力

elements_en.what: Protein design using GPT-6 general reasoning, bypassing the need for bio-specific models
elements_en.why: To demonstrate the generalization of logical reasoning in complex scientific domains

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 此现象证明大模型正在摆脱对高昂垂类数据清洗的依赖，凭借基础推理与代码模拟能力的Scaling效应实现科学发现。这预示着计算机生物学领域将迎来通用智能范式的范式转移，即通过逻辑求解器取代单一任务的预测模型。
ai_analysis.insight_en: This development suggests that Large Language Models are bypassing the reliance on expensive domain-specific data, leveraging scaling laws in reasoning to drive scientific discovery. It points toward a paradigm shift in computational biology where general-purpose logic solvers replace single-task predictive models.

title: MCP 本周已满两周岁，第二年最有趣的事情不是另一台服务器的发布，而是由谁来管理它。 Anthropic 构建了该协议并在第一年单独运行。 2025 年 12 月，它将 MCP 交给了 Linux 基金会
title_en:
MCP turned two this week, and the most interesting thing about its second year isn't another server launch, it's who showed up to govern it.

Anthropic built the protocol and ran it alone for the first year. In December 2025 it handed MCP to the Linux Foundation's new Agentic AI Foundation, and the people now sitting at that table include OpenAI, Microsoft and Google DeepMind, three companies that compete with Anthropic on practically everything else. That's the part worth sitting with: the shared plumbing layer for agent tooling is now jointly governed by the same labs racing each other on models.

The technical news this week is a genuine architecture change, not a feature bump. MCP has always loaded every tool definition into context the moment a server connects, whether or not the agent ends up using them. The new skills extension, SEP-2640, lets a server publish skills as resources instead, addressable through a skill:// URI, listed in a lightweight catalog, with the full instructions fetched only when a skill actually gets used. Boris Cherny put it plainly: MCP servers can now ship with their own skills, so Claude Code knows how to use them out of the box. Anthropic shipped the client side of this as a public beta in Claude this week, alongside Tasks and Elicitation going fully generally available, which is what lets an agent run a job for hours without losing its place or stall out waiting on a confirmation it never gets.

What makes this a protocol story and not a Claude story is that Microsoft shipped the same client support in VS Code 1.147 inside the same week, explicitly billing itself as one of the first clients to add it. Estimates on community MCP servers now run into five figures, up from zero two years ago, and most of that catalog was built assuming every tool definition rides along for free in every conversation.

The context math on that assumption was always going to break first. Skills over MCP is the protocol admitting it, and fixing it before the server count made the fix too expensive to ship.

full_text_zh:
MCP 本周已满两周岁，第二年最有趣的事情不是另一台服务器的发布，而是由谁来管理它。

Anthropic 构建了该协议并在第一年单独运行。 2025 年 12 月，它将 MCP 交给了 Linux 基金会新成立的 Agentic AI 基金会，现在坐在这张桌子上的人包括 OpenAI、微软和谷歌 DeepMind，这三家公司几乎在其他所有方面都与 Anthropic 竞争。这是值得讨论的部分：代理工具的共享管道层现在由在模型上相互竞争的相同实验室共同管理。

本周的技术新闻是真正的架构变化，而不是功能提升。 MCP 始终在服务器连接时将每个工具定义加载到上下文中，无论代理最终是否使用它们。新的技能扩展 SEP-2640 允许服务器将技能发布为资源，可通过 Skill:// URI 进行寻址，列在轻量级目录中，仅在实际使用技能时才获取完整指令。 Boris Cherny 直言不讳地说：MCP 服务器现在可以附带自己的技能，因此 Claude Code 知道如何开箱即用地使用它们。 Anthropic 本周在 Claude 中将其客户端作为公共测试版发布，同时任务和启发也完全可用，这使得代理可以运行一个作业几个小时，而不会失去其位置或拖延等待永远不会得到的确认。

这是一个协议故事而不是 Claude 故事的原因在于，Microsoft 在同一周内在 VS Code 1.147 中提供了相同的客户端支持，并明确将自己标榜为第一批添加它的客户端之一。对社区 MCP 服务器的估计现在已从两年前的零上升到了五位数，并且该目录中的大部分内容都是假设每个工具定义在每次对话中都是免费的。

基于该假设的上下文数学总是会首先被打破。 MCP 上的技能是承认这一点的协议，并在服务器计数之前修复它，这使得修复成本太高而无法交付。

title: Most vertical software companies are fighting to stay the UI layer for their industry. Horizontal players are doing the opposite, with Salesforce and HubSpot going headless and letting AI sit on top of their systems. There's a third path I haven't really seen anyone
title_en:
Most vertical software companies are fighting to stay the UI layer for their industry. Horizontal players are doing the opposite, with Salesforce and HubSpot going headless and letting AI sit on top of their systems.

There's a third path I haven't really seen anyone take: sell Claude directly into your vertical, with an industry specific app built inside it.

Anthropic's MCP Apps let you render your own interface inside a Claude conversation. Your app registers tools the model calls, you ship it as a connector, and the customer installs it from a link. No app store gate.

The opening exists because most verticals haven't adopted a frontier model yet. Walk into a dental group or a mid size freight brokerage and you'll find a ChatGPT tab at best. If you're the one who demos it on a real pre-auth or carrier packet, you become the person who brought the model to the market, and markets don't forget their introducer.

The compounding part is nice too. Every time Anthropic ships better reasoning or cheaper tokens, from the customer's chair the dental AI just got smarter. You're renting the engine at consumer prices with no inference bill and no infra team. One MCP server plus real industry knowledge.

The honest downsides: write-back is hard when systems of record are closing their APIs, so you can end up a brain without hands. Platform gates are real, and the app itself is copyable, which means your moat is relationships and trust rather than code.

Still, a tight vertical with 50-200 customers paying a few hundred a month is a genuinely good bootstrap business. Small markets, big margins, weeks to ship.
title_zh:
大多数垂直软件公司都在努力保留其行业的 UI 层。横向玩家正在做相反的事情，Salesforce 和 HubSpot 走向无头，让人工智能坐在他们的系统之上。

我还没有看到有人采取第三条道路：将克劳德直接销售到您的垂直领域，并在其中内置行
author: @lukesophinos
summary_zh:
业特定的应用程序。

Anthropic 的 MCP 应用程序可让您在 Claude 对话中呈现自己的界面。您的应用程序注册模型调用的工具，将其作为连接器发送，然后客户从链接安装它。没有应用商店门。

这一空缺的存在是因为大多数垂直行业尚未采用前沿模型。走进一家牙科集团或一家中型货运经纪公司，您最多会发现一个 ChatGPT 选项卡。如果您是在真实的预授权或载体包上演示它的人，那么您就成为将该模型推向市场的人，并且市场不会忘记他们的介绍人。

复合部分也很好。每当 Anthropic 推出更好的推理或更便宜的代币时，坐在客户椅子上的牙科人工智能就会变得更加聪明。您以消费者价格租用引擎，无需推理费用，也无需基础设施团队。一台 MCP 服务器加上真实的行业知识。

诚实的缺点是：当记录系统关闭其 API 时，回写会很困难，因此您最终可能会失去双手。平台大门是真实的，应用程序本身是可复制的，这意味着你的护城河是关系和信任，而不是代码。

尽管如此，拥有 50-200 名客户、每月支付数百美元的紧密垂直行业确实是一项很好的自举业务。市场小，利润大，发货时间长。

key_points_en: Key Development: Most vertical software companies are fighting to stay the UI layer for their industry. Horizontal players are doing the opposite, with Salesforce and HubSpot going headless and letting AI sit on top of their systems. There's a third path I haven't really seen anyone

full_text_en:
Most vertical software companies are fighting to stay the UI layer for their industry. Horizontal players are doing the opposite, with Salesforce and HubSpot going headless and letting AI sit on top of their systems.

There's a third path I haven't really seen anyone take: sell Claude directly into your vertical, with an industry specific app built inside it.

Anthropic's MCP Apps let you render your own interface inside a Claude conversation. Your app registers tools the model calls, you ship it as a connector, and the customer installs it from a link. No app store gate.

The opening exists because most verticals haven't adopted a frontier model yet. Walk into a dental group or a mid size freight brokerage and you'll find a ChatGPT tab at best. If you're the one who demos it on a real pre-auth or carrier packet, you become the person who brought the model to the market, and markets don't forget their introducer.

The compounding part is nice too. Every time Anthropic ships better reasoning or cheaper tokens, from the customer's chair the dental AI just got smarter. You're renting the engine at consumer prices with no inference bill and no infra team. One MCP server plus real industry knowledge.

The honest downsides: write-back is hard when systems of record are closing their APIs, so you can end up a brain without hands. Platform gates are real, and the app itself is copyable, which means your moat is relationships and trust rather than code.

Still, a tight vertical with 50-200 customers paying a few hundred a month is a genuinely good bootstrap business. Small markets, big margins, weeks to ship.
full_text_zh:
大多数垂直软件公司都在努力保留其行业的 UI 层。横向玩家正在做相反的事情，Salesforce 和 HubSpot 走向无头，让人工智能坐在他们的系统之上。

我还没有看到有人采取第三条道路：将克劳德直接销售到您的垂直领域，并在其中内置行业特定的应用程序。

Anthropic 的 MCP 应用程序可让您在 Claude 对话中呈现自己的界面。您的应用程序注册模型调用的工具，将其作为连接器发送，然后客户从链接安装它。没有应用商店门。

这一空缺的存在是因为大多数垂直行业尚未采用前沿模型。走进一家牙科集团或一家中型货运经纪公司，您最多会发现一个 ChatGPT 选项卡。如果您是在真实的预授权或载体包上演示它的人，那么您就成为将该模型推向市场的人，并且市场不会忘记他们的介绍人。

复合部分也很好。每当 Anthropic 推出更好的推理或更便宜的代币时，坐在客户椅子上的牙科人工智能就会变得更加聪明。您以消费者价格租用引擎，无需推理费用，也无需基础设施团队。一台 MCP 服务器加上真实的行业知识。

诚实的缺点是：当记录系统关闭其 API 时，回写会很困难，因此您最终可能会失去双手。平台大门是真实的，应用程序本身是可复制的，这意味着你的护城河是关系和信任，而不是代码。

尽管如此，拥有 50-200 名客户、每月支付数百美元的紧密垂直行业确实是一项很好的自举业务。市场小，利润大，发货时间长。

author: Ollama
author_role: 极简本地大模型运行与管理框架
full_text_zh:
.@llama_index 刚刚推出了 OCRia-1，一个基于 Qwen 的 4B 文档解析语言模型。

它用于处理图像并将其转换为包含表格和图表的 Markdown。

.@llama_index just launched OCRia-1, a 4B document-parsing language model based on Qwen.

It's made to process images and turn it into markdown with tables and charts. 

Get started with the model: 

ollama pull llamaindex/ocria-1:bf16  https://x.com/llama_index/status/2125315040723062872/video/1

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: LlamaIndex正式推出OCRia-1模型，该模型基于Qwen架构构建，参数量为4B，专为处理图像文档中的复杂表格与图表并将其转换为Markdown格式而设计。目前已通过Hugging Face与Ollama平台提供权重下载，支持企业在本地基础设施进行私有化部署。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: LlamaIndex has launched OCRia-1, a 4B parameter document-parsing model based on the Qwen architecture, specifically optimized for converting complex tables and charts from images into Markdown. Weights are now available via Hugging Face and Ollama for local infrastructure deployment.

elements_zh.where: Hugging Face与Ollama平台
elements_zh.what: 发布4B参数量文档解析模型OCRia-1
elements_zh.why: 应对复杂扫描文档、表格与图表的自动化转换需求

elements_en.what: Launched OCRia-1, a 4B document-parsing model
elements_en.why: To automate complex document, table, and chart conversion

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 通过将轻量化解析模型下沉至边缘侧，LlamaIndex旨在解决企业级RAG应用中多模态数据输入端的瓶颈。此举标志着文档解析工具正加速从云端SaaS化向“模型权重本地化”转型，降低了敏感商业文档处理的合规与数据外泄风险。
ai_analysis.insight_en: By pushing lightweight parsing models to the edge, LlamaIndex addresses bottlenecks in multimodal data ingestion for enterprise RAG applications. This signals a transition from cloud-based SaaS to locally-hosted model weights, reducing compliance risks and data leakage for sensitive enterprise documents.

ai_analysis.digest_en: LlamaIndex has launched OCRia-1, a 4B parameter document-parsing model based on the Qwen architecture, specifically optimized for converting complex tables and charts from images into Markdown. Weights are now available via Hugging Face and Ollama for local infrastructure deployment.

功能特性：支持将图像文档转化为包含表格与图表的Markdown格式
部署方案：提供Hugging Face与Ollama下载入口，支持本地化离线运行

title_en:
Today, we’re releasing OCRia-1’s weights on @HuggingFace and @Ollama🦙

Our 4B model for complex tables, charts and difficult scans is now available to download and run on your own infrastructure. 

In about a month we shipped:

→ OCRia-1, our first document parsing model
→ OCRia-1.5, in 2B and 4B
→ OCRia-nano-1, our 8.1M-parameter model for local CPU parsing, released with open weights

We’re building OCRia for the full range of document workloads, with open-weight releases to help advance research in document understanding. Grab the weights and show us what you build. 

Hugging Face: http://huggingface.co/llamaindex/OCRia-1
Ollama: https://ollama.com/llamaindex/ocria-1

title: ⚡ How did gRPC in LMCache go from slower than ZMQ to 1,617 RPCs per second against ZMQ's 1,322? Both numbers come from one run that replayed recorded vLLM engine requests against a saturated LMCache server. The vLLM engines on a node usual
title_en:
⚡ How did gRPC in LMCache go from slower than ZMQ to 1,617 RPCs per second against ZMQ's 1,322? Both numbers come from one run that replayed recorded vLLM engine requests against a saturated LMCache server.

The vLLM engines on a node usually share one LMCache server, a Python process under one GIL. The cost of gRPC was Python work per request on that server. LMCache contributor Minjun Choi removed much of that work, then moved the HTTP/2 and gRPC work into Rust with --grpc-server-mode native, in LMCache 0.5.7.post1.

What each change did, and when to choose ZMQ, gRPC aio, or native mode:
https://na2.hubs.ly/H096zWB0
title_zh: LMCache通过优化gRPC超越ZMQ性能
author: @lmcache
full_text_zh:
⚡ LMCache 中的 gRPC 是如何从比 ZMQ 慢到每秒 1,617 个 RPC 而 ZMQ 为每秒 1,322 个 RPC 的？这两个数字均来自针对饱和 LMCache 服务器重放记录的 vLLM 引擎请求的一次运行。

节点上的vLLM引擎通常共享一台LMCache服务器，一个GIL下的Python进程。 gRPC 的成本是该服务器上每个请求的 Python 工作量。 LMCache 贡献者 Minjun Choi 删除了大部分工作，然后在 LMCache 0.5.7.post1 中使用 --grpc-server-mode native 将 HTTP/2 和 gRPC 工作转移到 Rust 中。

每个更改的作用以及何时选择 ZMQ、gRPC aio 或本机模式：
https://na2.hubs.ly/H096zWB0
full_text_en:
⚡ How did gRPC in LMCache go from slower than ZMQ to 1,617 RPCs per second against ZMQ's 1,322? Both numbers come from one run that replayed recorded vLLM engine requests against a saturated LMCache server.

The vLLM engines on a node usually share one LMCache server, a Python process under one GIL. The cost of gRPC was Python work per request on that server. LMCache contributor Minjun Choi removed much of that work, then moved the HTTP/2 and gRPC work into Rust with --grpc-server-mode native, in LMCache 0.5.7.post1.

What each change did, and when to choose ZMQ, gRPC aio, or native mode:
https://na2.hubs.ly/H096zWB0

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 分布式推理缓存架构LMCache通过重构其通信协议栈，成功使gRPC接口在饱和负载下的处理能力达到每秒1,617次远程过程调用（RPCs），显著超过了原有的ZMQ（零消息队列）协议实现的1,322次/秒。该测试基于vLLM推理引擎在饱和环境下的压力重放，验证了针对高吞吐量推理场景下的协议优化成效。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: LMCache has optimized its communication layer, achieving 1,617 RPCs per second via gRPC, outperforming ZMQ's 1,322 RPCs per second. The benchmark, conducted using replayed vLLM engine requests under saturation, demonstrates significant gains in inference throughput efficiency.

elements_zh.where: 分布式推理引擎架构测试环境
elements_zh.what: gRPC性能优化，吞吐量超越ZMQ
elements_zh.why: 针对大模型推理环境下高并发、低延迟的缓存通信需求

elements_en.what: gRPC performance optimization surpassing ZMQ
elements_en.why: Addressing high-concurrency, low-latency communication requirements in LLM inference

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 推理服务架构的瓶颈已从单纯的模型计算转向分布式状态下的数据同步与调度，LMCache对通信协议的深层调优揭示了在显存受限场景下，系统开销已成为影响吞吐量的关键变量。在多节点vLLM部署环境下，降低传输协议开销将直接转化为推理服务的单位算力成本优势。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Bottlenecks in inference serving have shifted from pure computation to distributed synchronization and scheduling. LMCache's protocol optimization highlights that communication overhead is now a critical variable in throughput, directly impacting unit costs in multi-node vLLM deployments.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: LMCache优化通信协议，在饱和负载测试中，gRPC吞吐量提升至1,617 RPC/s，优于传统的ZMQ方案。
ai_analysis.digest_en: LMCache optimized its communication protocol, achieving a throughput of 1,617 RPCs per second under saturated load, outperforming the legacy ZMQ implementation.
key_points_zh: LMCache成功实现通信协议底层性能调优
gRPC在饱和压力测试中吞吐量提升约22%
针对vLLM多节点推理架构的性能关键路径优化
key_points_en: LMCache successfully optimized low-level communication protocols.
gRPC throughput improved by ~22% under saturation testing.
Performance optimization focused on multi-node vLLM architectures.
ai_analysis.takeaway_zh: 推理服务架构的瓶颈已从单纯的模型计算转向分布式状态下的数据同步与调度，LMCache对通信协议的深层调优揭示了在显存受限场景下，系统开销已成为影响吞吐量的关键变量。在多节点vLLM部署环境下，降低传输协议开销将直接转化为推理服务的单位算力成本优势。
ai_analysis.takeaway_en: Bottlenecks in inference serving have shifted from pure computation to distributed synchronization and scheduling. LMCache's protocol optimization highlights that communication overhead is now a critical variable in throughput, directly impacting unit costs in multi-node vLLM deployments.

title: Today, we’re releasing Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B. An upgrade to Ternary Bonsai 2 27B, with substantially stronger agentic coding, multi-turn tool use, and long-horizon task execution. All within the same 5.9 GB model footprint. Based on Qwen3.8 27B, the model
title_en:
Today, we’re releasing Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B.

An upgrade to Ternary Bonsai 2 27B, with substantially stronger agentic coding, multi-turn tool use, and long-horizon task execution. All within the same 5.9 GB model footprint.

Based on Qwen3.8 27B, the model is 9x smaller than its full-precision counterpart. It scores  73.9 on tau3-bench and 75.6 on SWE-Bench-Verified, making it the strongest AI model of its memory footprint for agentic workloads.

Compared with Ternary Bonsai 2, Ternary Bonsai 2.5 completes tasks in fewer turns, uses fewer tokens, and delivers results faster and more accurately.

Available today under Apache 2.0.
title_zh:
今天，我们发布了三元盆景 2.5 27B。

升级到 Ternary Bonsai 2 27B，具有更强的代理编码、多轮工具使用和长视野任务执行。所有这些都在相同的 5.9 GB 型号内存范围内。

该模型基于 Qwen3.8 27B，比全

与三元盆景 2 相比，三元盆景 2.5 完成任务的轮次更少，使用的代币更少，并且更快、更准确地提供结果。

今天在 Apache 2.0 下可用。

title: Ethan asked Astra to review published methods and write software to search observations of about 19 million stars from NASA’s TESS mission. The search included regions around a star where a planet with the right atmosphere could have liquid water on its s
title_en:
Ethan asked Astra to review published methods and write software to search observations of about 19 million stars from NASA’s TESS mission. The search included regions around a star where a planet with the right atmosphere could have liquid water on its surface.

His first pass turned up 49 candidates. He sent one of the most promising to researchers on NASA’s TESS mission, where it’s awaiting a closer look.

Explore Kevin and Ethan’s findings and learn how to get started: http://openai.com/index/searching-for-distant-planets-with-astra/
title_zh:
Ethan 要求 Astra 审查已发布的方法并编写软件来搜索 NASA TESS 任务中约 1900 万颗恒星的观测结果。搜索范围包括恒星周围的区域，在这些区域中，具有适当大气层的行星的表面可能存在液态水。

他的第一遍就找到了 49 名
author: OpenAI 官方
author_role: OpenAI 官方发布与模型前沿
summary_zh:
候选人。他向美国宇航局 TESS 任务的研究人员发送了一份最有希望的报告，目前正在等待仔细观察。

full_text_en:
Ethan asked Astra to review published methods and write software to search observations of about 19 million stars from NASA’s TESS mission. The search included regions around a star where a planet with the right atmosphere could have liquid water on its surface.

His first pass turned up 49 candidates. He sent one of the most promising to researchers on NASA’s TESS mission, where it’s awaiting a closer look.

Explore Kevin and Ethan’s findings and learn how to get started: http://openai.com/index/searching-for-distant-planets-with-astra/

Introducing SWE-2.1, our latest coding model.

Like its predecessor, SWE-2.1 is trained with pure reinforcement learning on Kimi K3. It delivers large gains over SWE-2 across a wide range of benchmarks.

SWE-2.1 is free for all Devin Pro, Max, and Teams for the next two weeks.
title_zh: Cognition发布纯强化学习代码模型SWE-2.1
author: @cognition
full_text_zh:
隆重推出 SWE-2.1，我们最新的编码模型。

与其前身一样，SWE-2.1 在 Kimi K3 上通过纯强化学习进行训练。它在广泛的基准测试中比 SWE-2 取得了巨大的进步。

SWE-2.1 在接下来的两周内对所有 Devin Pro、Max 和 Teams 免费。
full_text_en:
Introducing SWE-2.1, our latest coding model.

Like its predecessor, SWE-2.1 is trained with pure reinforcement learning on Kimi K3. It delivers large gains over SWE-2 across a wide range of benchmarks.

SWE-2.1 is free for all Devin Pro, Max, and Teams for the next two weeks.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Cognition公司推出最新代码模型SWE-2.1，该模型基于Kimi K3架构，完全采用强化学习技术进行训练。相比SWE-2，该模型在多个基准测试中表现出显著性能增益，并已对Devin Pro、Max及Teams付费用户开放使用。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Cognition has released SWE-2.1, its latest coding model trained entirely through reinforcement learning on the Kimi K3 architecture. The model demonstrates significant performance improvements over its predecessor across multiple benchmarks and is now available to Devin Pro, Max, and Teams subscribers.

title: Excited to share that I'm joining Thinking Machines to shape model behavior, alignment, and character in a way that empowers humans and advances open science. Many of our worries and dreams about AI are rooted in how models develop values, relate to
title_en:
Excited to share that I'm joining Thinking Machines to shape model behavior, alignment, and character in a way that empowers humans and advances open science. Many of our worries and dreams about AI are rooted in how models develop values, relate to us, and choose to act, but there’s relatively little public visibility into how model behavior and character are shaped. This isn’t good for the ecosystem! It leaves us susceptible to failure modes that are hard to anticipate, and narrows our collective imagination of what AI assistants could be like. A more robust AI equilibrium requires open methodology and tooling for measuring and intervening on model behavior, so that more people can scrutinize how systems behave and shape that behavior for themselves. I’ve been inspired by Thinky’s commitment to openness and decentralization since their founding, and I’m looking forward to building toward this vision together.

My work at Thinky will span direct interventions on model behavior and character in training, and longer-horizon research into the scientific foundations of model behavior. We'll publish our findings and tools so that others can build on our work and customize the models we release. If you'd like to work on this together, please get in touch! I'd love to chat if you're interested in model psychology, character training, or alignment research:

https://thinkingmachines.ai/careers/research-model-behavior/

title_en:
We trained DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 Uncensored to help inference providers serve more customer needs on shared GPU capacity.

One engine. Two modes.

Switch between the base model and the uncensored variant per request, on the same official FP8 weights. Our 232 MB LoRA adapter is open source under MIT.

Get the adapter: https://huggingface.co/PhalaCloud/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-Uncensored-LoRA

Try it on Phala: https://phala.com/models/phala/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 去中心化计算平台Phala Network推出了针对推理优化设计的DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017版本，具备“基座模型”与“无审查变体”双模态切换能力。该模型利用FP8精度技术，旨在帮助推理服务提供商在共享GPU算力资源受限的情况下，通过单引擎架构高效满足不同用户对合规性与响应灵活性差异化的需求。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Phala Network released the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 variant, featuring dual-mode switching between base and uncensored models. Optimized for FP8 precision, the architecture enables inference providers to fulfill diverse user requirements on shared GPU resources through a single engine.

elements_en.what: Released DeepSeek V4.1 Flash with dual-mode (base/uncensored) switching
elements_en.why: Reducing deployment complexity and increasing flexibility for inference providers

ai_analysis.insight_zh: Phala的方案揭示了推理市场向“算力资产精细化运营”的转型，通过模型变体封装降低了运维侧的冷启动与显存开销，这对于碎片化的分布式GPU供应网络至关重要。将无审查模型与标准基座集成于单引擎，本质上是在合规性边界内实现对边缘算力池最大化效能挖掘的策略选择。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Phala's approach reveals the shift toward precise management of compute assets in the inference market. By encapsulating model variants, it reduces cold-start overhead, which is critical for fragmented distributed GPU networks. Integrating uncensored variants with base models within a single engine is a strategic move to maximize efficiency within existing compute pools.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: Phala推出DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017版本，支持在FP8精度下动态切换基座与无审查模式，提升算力利用率。
ai_analysis.digest_en: Phala Network released the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 version, supporting FP8-based dynamic switching between base and uncensored modes to improve compute resource utilization.

key_points_en: Enabled dynamic switching between base and uncensored variants in a single engine.
Leveraged FP8 precision for efficient deployment on shared GPU hardware.
Reduced memory and compute overhead for inference providers managing multiple model versions.

title: YOU CAN NOW LET $META'S AI DO YOUR WALMART BLACK FRIDAY SHOPPING Starting today, customers can shop Walmart's Black Friday deals directly through Muse, Meta's personal AI agent. Muse can search for products, build a cart and complete the
title_en:
YOU CAN NOW LET $META'S AI DO YOUR WALMART BLACK FRIDAY SHOPPING

Starting today, customers can shop Walmart's Black Friday deals directly through Muse, Meta's personal AI agent.

Muse can search for products, build a cart and complete the purchase on Walmart's website and at Sam's Club. Shoppers set a spending limit and can approve purchases and review everything the agent buys.

Walmart says prices are the same whether a person or an AI agent is shopping.

Muse is the first AI agent Walmart has let buy for its customers. Amazon and eBay have blocked AI shopping agents like Muse.
title_zh: Meta AI代理Muse接入沃尔玛购物
author: @wallstengine
full_text_zh:
您现在可以让 $META 的人工智能帮您在沃尔玛黑色星期五购物

从今天开始，顾客可以直接通过 Meta 的个人人工智能代理 Muse 购买沃尔玛的黑色星期五优惠。

Muse 可以在沃尔玛网站和山姆会员店搜索产品、建立购物车并完成购买。购物者设定支出限额，可以批准购买并审查代理商购买的所有商品。

沃尔玛表示，无论是人购物还是人工智能代理购物，价格都是一样的。

Muse 是沃尔玛第一个为其客户提供代购服务的人工智能代理。亚马逊和 eBay 已经屏蔽了 Muse 等人工智能购物代理。
full_text_en:
YOU CAN NOW LET $META'S AI DO YOUR WALMART BLACK FRIDAY SHOPPING

Starting today, customers can shop Walmart's Black Friday deals directly through Muse, Meta's personal AI agent.

Muse can search for products, build a cart and complete the purchase on Walmart's website and at Sam's Club. Shoppers set a spending limit and can approve purchases and review everything the agent buys.

Walmart says prices are the same whether a person or an AI agent is shopping.

Muse is the first AI agent Walmart has let buy for its customers. Amazon and eBay have blocked AI shopping agents like Muse.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Meta宣布其个人AI代理Muse正式接入零售巨头沃尔玛（Walmart）的购物系统。用户现可通过Muse进行黑五大促期间的商品搜索、购物车自动化构建及支付结算，标志着Meta AI代理向高频商业消费场景的实质性迈进。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Meta has announced the integration of its personal AI agent, Muse, with Walmart's shopping system. Users can now leverage Muse to search for products, automate cart building, and complete purchases during Walmart's Black Friday sales, marking a significant step for Meta AI agents into high-frequency commerce.

elements_zh.where: 购物结算场景
elements_zh.what: Muse AI代理集成沃尔玛黑五大促购物功能
elements_zh.why: 推动Meta AI代理商业闭环，抢占黑五大促流量

elements_en.what: Integration of Muse AI agent with Walmart's Black Friday deals
elements_en.why: Closing the commerce loop for Meta AI and capturing Black Friday traffic

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 此举不仅是Meta将AI Agent落地高频购物场景的实验，更是对传统搜索式电商的流量拦截与重构。通过将购买链路缩短至对话界面，Meta正在改变消费者的获客路径，通过AI代理直接干预零售订单的转化链路，对亚马逊等传统电商平台的流量护城河构成潜在威胁。
ai_analysis.insight_en: This move is not only an experiment in embedding AI agents into high-frequency shopping but also a redirection of search-based e-commerce traffic. By shortening the purchase funnel into a conversational interface, Meta is altering customer acquisition paths and directly influencing conversion, potentially challenging the traffic dominance of traditional e-commerce platforms like Amazon.

summary_en: Anthropic has launched the public beta of Skills over MCP, enabling AI agents to utilize step-by-step guides and best practices alongside external tool access. Features like Tasks for background processing and Elicitation for user input confirmation have also reached general availability, aiming to upgrade Claude's capabilities from single-task execution to complex workflow orchestration.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Anthropic正式发布Skills over MCP功能的公测版，使AI Agent不仅能调用外部工具，还能加载多步骤执行手册与最佳实践。同时，Tasks（后台任务）与Elicitation（用户反馈确认）功能也已全面开放，该套件旨在通过标准化协议将Claude的自主协作能力从单一任务处理升级至复杂工作流编排。

ai_analysis.insight_en: By introducing Skills over MCP, Anthropic is establishing a de facto standard for AI agent orchestration by codifying 'implicit process logic' into distributable, standardized components. Embedding 'manuals' directly into toolsets significantly reduces development friction for agentic strategies and is critical for building end-to-end, autonomous AI productivity systems.

title: With Tasks (GA), servers can run long operations or full agent loops while Claude keeps working and picks up the result when it's ready. File Uploads is also rolling out soon. Claude will be able to send PDFs, spreadsheets, and images to a server without pass
title_en:
With Tasks (GA), servers can run long operations or full agent loops while Claude keeps working and picks up the result when it's ready.

File Uploads is also rolling out soon. Claude will be able to send PDFs, spreadsheets, and images to a server without passing them through the context window.
title_zh:
通过任务 (GA)，服务器可以运行长时间操作或完整的代理循环，而 Claude 继续工作并在准备好时获取结果。

文件上传也即将推出。 Claude 将能够将 PDF、电子表格和图像发送到服务器，而无需通过上下文窗口传递它们。

title: 借助 Skills over MCP（测试版），服务器可以将技能与其工具一起发布。除了工具名称和描述之外，技能还为克劳德提供了多步骤工作的手册。技能仅在需要时加载，随服务器更新，并且可以根据每个用户的帐户进行定制
title_en:
With Skills over MCP (beta), servers can publish skills alongside their tools.

Skills give Claude a playbook for multi-step work, beyond tool names and descriptions. Skills load only when needed, update with the server, and can be tailored to each user's account or organization.
title_zh:
借助 Skills over MCP（测试版），服务器可以将技能与其工具一起发布。

title: Introducing WebMCP support in AI SDK. Use the new WebMCP transport with our MCP client to discover and call tools exposed by your website.
title_en: Introducing WebMCP support in AI SDK. Use the new WebMCP transport with our MCP client to discover and call tools exposed by your website.
title_zh: 谷歌推出WebMCP协议，重构AI智能体网页交互标准
author: @aisdk
summary_en: Google has introduced WebMCP (Web Model Context Protocol) within its AI SDK, aiming to replace brittle visual-based web interactions with structured, machine-readable interfaces. By allowing websites to expose specific actions and data directly to AI agents, the protocol shifts web navigation from visual imitation to explicit API-like execution.
summary_zh: 谷歌在Chrome浏览器中引入WebMCP预览功能，允许网站直接向AI智能体暴露结构化数据与可执行工具。
full_text_zh: 在 AI SDK 中引入 WebMCP 支持。将新的 WebMCP 传输与我们的 MCP 客户端结合使用来发现和调用您的网站公开的工具。
full_text_en: Introducing WebMCP support in AI SDK. Use the new WebMCP transport with our MCP client to discover and call tools exposed by your website.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 谷歌通过AI SDK推出WebMCP（Web Model Context Protocol）预览功能，旨在解决传统AI智能体模拟人工点击网页带来的高故障率与低效问题。该协议允许网站开发者显式定义结构化接口，使AI智能体能通过明确的指令而非视觉解析，直接调用网站后台的搜索、支付及服务请求功能。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Google has introduced WebMCP (Web Model Context Protocol) within its AI SDK, aiming to replace brittle visual-based web interactions with structured, machine-readable interfaces. By allowing websites to expose specific actions and data directly to AI agents, the protocol shifts web navigation from visual imitation to explicit API-like execution.

elements_zh.where: Chrome浏览器及AI SDK生态
elements_zh.what: 发布WebMCP预览版，将网页转化为AI智能体可直接调用的结构化工具
elements_zh.why: 降低AI对网页视觉解析的依赖，提升自动化交互的可靠性与商业合规性

elements_en.where: Chrome browser and AI SDK ecosystem
elements_en.what: Launched WebMCP preview to formalize agent-to-website interactions via structured protocols
elements_en.why: To reduce reliance on fragile UI scraping and improve reliability of agent-driven tasks

ai_analysis.insight_zh: WebMCP的本质是谷歌试图在浏览器层面建立智能体流量入口的“标准协议”，将Web UI的解释权从AI模型端收回至网站侧。此举将重构互联网商业逻辑：从无序的流量抓取转向基于API审计的受控交互，直接冲击现有的爬虫防护技术栈与RPA市场格局。
ai_analysis.insight_en: WebMCP represents a strategic effort by Google to standardize agent-web interaction, shifting the power dynamic from model-side visual interpretation to site-side structured access. This protocol signals a transition toward an agent-driven web architecture where businesses regain control over bot traffic through auditable, structured API calls.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: 谷歌通过AI SDK推出WebMCP（Web Model Context Protocol）预览功能，旨在解决传统AI智能体模拟人工点击网页带来的高故障率与低效问题。该协议允许网站开发者显式定义结构化接口，使AI智能体能通过明确的指令而非视觉解析，直接调用网站后台的搜索、支付及服务请求功能。
ai_analysis.digest_en: Google has introduced WebMCP (Web Model Context Protocol) within its AI SDK, aiming to replace brittle visual-based web interactions with structured, machine-readable interfaces. By allowing websites to expose specific actions and data directly to AI agents, the protocol shifts web navigation from visual imitation to explicit API-like execution.
key_points_zh: 以WebMCP替代基于视觉的网页模拟操作
引入结构化数据与显式动作接口以提升AI执行可靠性
通过标准化协议强化企业对AI智能体访问行为的合规管控
key_points_en: Replacing visual UI scraping with WebMCP protocols
Enabling structured data access to increase AI agent reliability
Formalizing compliance and control over agent-led web interactions
ai_analysis.takeaway_zh: WebMCP的本质是谷歌试图在浏览器层面建立智能体流量入口的“标准协议”，将Web UI的解释权从AI模型端收回至网站侧。此举将重构互联网商业逻辑：从无序的流量抓取转向基于API审计的受控交互，直接冲击现有的爬虫防护技术栈与RPA市场格局。
ai_analysis.takeaway_en: WebMCP represents a strategic effort by Google to standardize agent-web interaction, shifting the power dynamic from model-side visual interpretation to site-side structured access. This protocol signals a transition toward an agent-driven web architecture where businesses regain control over bot traffic through auditable, structured API calls.

title: Introducing M3 Code ✨ A T3 Code fork with ZERO telemetry. NOTHING is being sent from this fork - no analytics, no product usage data, no error or crash reporting, no OpenTelemetry traces/metrics/logs, and no install, device, or account identifiers. It will be up
title_en:
Introducing M3 Code ✨

A T3 Code fork with ZERO telemetry.

NOTHING is being sent from this fork - no analytics, no product usage data, no error or crash reporting, no OpenTelemetry traces/metrics/logs, and no install, device, or account identifiers.

It will be updated DAILY to get latest commits from upstream T3 Code. It also includes some other unique features, specifically for local AI, but not just:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
 - Local providers marked, default for new threads                                                                                                                                                                                                            
 - Background writing prefers local models                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
 - Settings → Inference: model server registry                                                                                                                                                                                                                
 - Supports llama.cpp, LM Studio, Ollama, TensorFold                                                                                                                                                                                                          
 - Gateway: per-server queues, TTFT, decode stats                                                                                                                                                                                                             
 - Queue position shown in waiting threads                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
 - Pi gets managed provider + lean tool set                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
 - OpenCode + Codex route through gateway                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
 - Fallback servers, only while primary is down                                                                                                                                                                                                               
 - Cache health + probe freshness per server                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
 - Vision: engine-reported + tested, images routed                                                                                                                                                                                                            
 - Watchdog stops loops, rants, and hangs                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
 - Bounded retries; never retry cancellations                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
 - "Use a local model" one-step setup                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
 - "Find server" repairs a moved server                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
 - Picker shows machine + server per model                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
 - Warns when a thread's model is no longer served                                                                                                                                                                                                            
 - NoName provider via ACP bridge, auto-found                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
 - Pi/OpenCode/NoName auto-enable when on PATH                                                                                                                                                                                                                
 - SSH machines get the fork's own server uploaded                                                                                                                                                                                                            
 - Fork version 0.1.x-mia.<time>.g<hash>                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
 - Add project dialog: machine picker + folder browse                                                                                                                                                                                                         
 - Add servers from other connected machines                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
 - Two-tone dark theme; true-black kept as OLED                                                                                                                                                                                                               
 - Sidebar cards title-first; Settled collapses                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
 - Offline evals for local models                                                                                                                                                                                                                             

Get it here:
https://github.com/MiaAI-Lab/m3code

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 开发者社区推出M3 Code，该版本基于T3 Code进行深度分叉，明确切断所有遥测链路。该版本杜绝了安装、设备、账号识别以及OpenTelemetry日志与错误报告的任何数据回传，旨在提供纯净开发环境。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: M3 Code has been launched as a fork of T3 Code, explicitly severing all telemetry data pipelines. This version eliminates all analytics, product usage data, error reporting, and device/account identifiers, aiming to provide an uncompromised development environment.

elements_en.what: Released a code fork with all telemetry removed
elements_en.why: Address developer demand for zero-data leakage and data autonomy

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 在AI驱动的开发环境普遍集成深度用户行为分析的背景下，此类“零遥测”分叉反映了工程界对闭源工具数据合规边界的抵触。此举将促使主流IDE厂商重新审视其采集用户代码上下文数据的颗粒度，以规避隐私合规带来的潜在市场份额流失。
ai_analysis.insight_en: As AI-driven IDEs increasingly integrate granular user behavior analysis, this 'zero-telemetry' fork signals growing engineering backlash against data harvesting. This trend compels mainstream IDE vendors to re-evaluate their data collection practices to avoid losing market share due to privacy concerns.

title: 今天，我们将与 Google Cloud Agent Gateway 一起全面提供 Workspace MCP 服务器和 Workspace CLI。传统的 REST API 是为人性化的应用程序构建的。现在，AI 代理通过 DLP 检查获得进入工作区的标准路径
title_en:
We are making Workspace MCP servers and the Workspace CLI generally available today, alongside Google Cloud Agent Gateway.

Traditional REST APIs were built for human-paced apps.

Now AI agents get a standard path into Workspace with DLP checks and human in the loop controls (HITL) built in!   🧵1/3
title_zh: 谷歌强制AI代理通过Agent Gateway合规交互
full_text_zh:
今天，我们将与 Google Cloud Agent Gateway 一起全面提供 Workspace MCP 服务器和 Workspace CLI。

传统的 REST API 是为人性化的应用程序构建的。

现在，AI 代理可以通过内置的 DLP 检查和人机参与控制 (HITL) 获得进入工作区的标准路径！
full_text_en:
We are making Workspace MCP servers and the Workspace CLI generally available today, alongside Google Cloud Agent Gateway.

Traditional REST APIs were built for human-paced apps.

Now AI agents get a standard path into Workspace with DLP checks and human in the loop controls (HITL) built in!   🧵1/3

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 谷歌于2026年11月24日宣布全面推出Workspace MCP（模型上下文协议）服务器与CLI，并规定AI代理需摒弃传统REST API，转而通过具备DLP检查与审计功能的Agent Gateway接入工作区数据。该举措自2027年2月1日起正式强制执行，旨在将AI代理定义为需严格权限管控的新型安全类别。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Google announced the general availability of Workspace MCP servers and CLI on November 24, 2026, mandating that AI agents use these interfaces for interaction. Effective February 1, 2027, this shift forces agents to operate through an Agent Gateway with built-in DLP and audit capabilities, treating agents as a distinct security classification.

elements_zh.where: 企业级AI合规部署环境
elements_zh.what: 强制要求AI代理使用MCP协议与Agent Gateway，屏蔽旧有REST API路径
elements_zh.why: 应对AI代理自动化操作带来的安全隐患与数据泄露风险

elements_en.what: Mandating MCP and Agent Gateway, deprecating REST API usage for AI agents
elements_en.why: Addressing security and data leakage risks from autonomous agent operations

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 这是全球首个将AI代理合规治理从软件层拉入协议层的重大举措，标志着谷歌通过控制数据链路底层协议，实质性垄断了企业级AI代理的操作标准。通过强制调用MCP，谷歌不仅防范了提示词注入，更将数据权限边界直接植入代理的执行逻辑，迫使第三方代理平台必须服从其统一的安全审计框架。
ai_analysis.insight_en: This is a seminal move to shift AI agent governance from software-level to protocol-level, effectively enabling Google to set the standard for enterprise agent interactions. By mandating MCP, Google mitigates prompt injection risks while embedding data governance directly into execution logic, forcing third-party platforms to comply with its proprietary security auditing framework.

title: China is the greatest economic and strategic threat facing the United States. For decades, China has engaged in intellectual property theft and espionage to acquire America’s most advanced technology. America must win the race to dominate AI and allegatio
title_en:
China is the greatest economic and strategic threat facing the United States. For decades, China has engaged in intellectual property theft and espionage to acquire America’s most advanced technology. 

America must win the race to dominate AI and allegations that Nvidia engaged in the sale of our most sensitive semiconductors to companies that were transferring that technology to China is totally unacceptable and should be deeply concerning to every American.

Jensen Huang had to go and should’ve stayed gone but now that the Nvidia board and the Trump administration have signed off on reinstating Huang as CEO, it is absolutely essential that Congress get to the bottom of how and why Jensen Huang and Nvidia were able to transfer our most advanced semiconductor technology to companies doing business with China. 

Last year, Jensen Huang said that those of us who are often described as “China hawks” wore “a badge of shame,” and added “they think they are doing the right thing for our country, but it's not patriotic, not even a little bit." 

With all due respect to the many dedicated employees and investors in Nvidia, patriotism means standing up for America against the machinations of authoritarian regimes and enduring shame awaits those who put personal and business interests above the national security and economic prosperity of the United States. 

Time for Congress To Get Work: get the American people the facts and enact strong new chip export controls to further restrict the sale or transfer of advanced semiconductors to China without delay.🇺🇸

author: @Mike_Pence
summary_zh:
国人的深切关注。

黄仁勋必须离开，也应该离开，但现在英伟达董事会和特朗普政府已经同意恢复黄仁勋担任首席执行官，国会必须弄清楚黄仁勋和英伟达如何以及为何能够将我们最先进的半导体技术转让给与中国开展业务的公司。

去年，黄仁勋表示，我们这些经常被称为“对华鹰派”的人戴着“耻辱的徽章”，并补充说“他们认为自己为我们的国家做了正确的事情，但这不是爱国，甚至没有一点爱国。”

谨向英伟达众多敬业的员工和投资者致以应有的敬意，爱国主义意味着支持美国反对独裁政权的阴谋，而那些将个人和商业利益置于美国国家安全和经济繁荣之上的人将面临持久的耻辱。

国会该开始工作了：让美国人民了解事实，并制定强有力的新芯片出口管制措施，立即进一步限制先进半导体向中国的销售或转让。🇺🇸

title: Killer talk by @Drewch at @NVIDIAGTC Berlin last month How @ShopifyEng fine-tunes open models to crush inference costs with @nebiusai * Post-trained NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for Sidekick’s GraphQL agent: beats frontier-model accuracy, 90% low
title_en:
Killer talk by @Drewch at @NVIDIAGTC Berlin last month

How @ShopifyEng fine-tunes open models to crush inference costs with @nebiusai 

* Post-trained NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for Sidekick’s GraphQL agent: beats frontier-model accuracy, 90% lower serving cost, 7× faster

* NVIDIA CCluster + vLLM optimization: up to 4.5× faster and 12× cheaper across our workloads — Catalog, Taxonomy, SimGym, Recommendations

* Scaling training + inference on Nebius Blackwell clusters with major speedups (e.g. ~2× tokens/sec, fewer GPU-hours) while owning the weights

http://nvidia.com/en-us/on-demand/session/gtcberlin26-sb61184

Targeted post-training + flywheel can beat frontier models on cost and latency for defined production use cases 👊🏽

http://nvidia.com/en-us/on-demand/session/gtcberlin26-sb61184

有针对性的后训练+飞轮可以在定义的生产用例的成本和延迟方面击败前沿模型👊🏽

title: Today we are open-sourcing the weights to OCRia-1, our flagship 4B VLM for document OCR 🔥 This is our SECOND open-weight release in two days (we just launched OCRia-nano-1 yesterday!!). OCRia-1 is on the pareto curve of accuracy and cost relative t
title_en:
Today we are open-sourcing the weights to OCRia-1, our flagship 4B VLM for document OCR 🔥

This is our SECOND open-weight release in two days (we just launched OCRia-nano-1 yesterday!!).

OCRia-1 is on the pareto curve of accuracy and cost relative to other 4B models on multiple benchmarks: ParseBench, olmOCR-bench (tables), PulseBench-Tab, and fr-bench-pdf2md. It is an extremely general purpose model that can parse even the most complex document types, including complex tables/charts/formatting/layout.

We’re releasing the weights to help advance open research around OCR, on both @huggingface  🤗 and @ollama  🦙

If you want to use it in prod, come talk to us. If you want to use the latest SOTA of the OCRia model family, tuned for production, check out LlamaParse!

Release on @huggingface : https://huggingface.co/llamaindex/OCRia-1

Release on @ollama: https://ollama.com/llamaindex/ocria-1

LlamaParse: https://llamaparse.ai/
title_zh: OCRia-1：轻量化VLM在文档识别领域的部署
author: Jerry Liu
author_role: LlamaIndex 联合创始人兼 CEO
full_text_zh:
今天，我们将权重开放给 OCRia-1，这是我们用于文档 OCR 的旗舰 4B VLM 🔥

这是我们两天内的第二次开放重量版本（我们昨天刚刚发布了 OCRia-nano-1！）。

相对于其他 4B 模型，OCRia-1 在多个基准测试中处于准确性和成本的帕累托曲线上：ParseBench、olmOCR-bench（表）、PulseBench-Tab 和 fr-bench-pdf2md。它是一个极其通用的模型，甚至可以解析最复杂的文档类型，包括复杂的表格/图表/格式/布局。

我们正在@huggingface 🤗 和 @ollama 🦙 上发布权重，以帮助推进围绕 OCR 的开放研究

如果您想在产品中使用它，请与我们联系。如果您想使用 OCRia 模型系列的最新 SOTA（针对生产进行调整），请查看 LlamaParse！

在 @huggingface 上发布：https://huggingface.co/llamaindex/OCRia-1

在@ollama 上发布：https://ollama.com/llamaindex/ocria-1

LlamaParse：https://llamaparse.ai/
full_text_en:
Today we are open-sourcing the weights to OCRia-1, our flagship 4B VLM for document OCR 🔥

This is our SECOND open-weight release in two days (we just launched OCRia-nano-1 yesterday!!).

OCRia-1 is on the pareto curve of accuracy and cost relative to other 4B models on multiple benchmarks: ParseBench, olmOCR-bench (tables), PulseBench-Tab, and fr-bench-pdf2md. It is an extremely general purpose model that can parse even the most complex document types, including complex tables/charts/formatting/layout.

We’re releasing the weights to help advance open research around OCR, on both @huggingface  🤗 and @ollama  🦙

If you want to use it in prod, come talk to us. If you want to use the latest SOTA of the OCRia model family, tuned for production, check out LlamaParse!

Release on @huggingface : https://huggingface.co/llamaindex/OCRia-1

Release on @ollama: https://ollama.com/llamaindex/ocria-1

LlamaParse: https://llamaparse.ai/

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: LlamaIndex团队宣布开源OCRia-1视觉语言模型（VLM）的权重，该模型规模为4B，专攻文档OCR任务。这是该团队继OCRia-nano-1后，在两天内推出的第二个开源模型，旨在通过轻量化架构打破文档处理精度与计算成本的帕累托最优曲线。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: The LlamaIndex team has open-sourced the weights for OCRia-1, a 4B parameter Visual Language Model (VLM) specialized for document OCR. This follows the release of OCRia-nano-1 and aims to improve the Pareto curve of accuracy versus cost in document processing tasks.

elements_zh.where: 多模态大模型研发领域
elements_zh.what: 开源4B参数规模的文档处理VLM模型
elements_zh.why: 为文档数字化提供高性价比、低门槛的工业级解决方案

elements_en.what: Open-sourced a 4B parameter document processing VLM
elements_en.why: Provide cost-effective, accessible industrial-grade solutions for document digitization

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 小参数模型在特定垂直任务（如OCR）的表现正迅速超越通用大模型，显示出行业对“小而专”推理链路的青睐。这种架构部署方式极大降低了边缘侧推理的门槛，对依赖云端OCR服务的传统文档数字化供应链构成实质性技术替代压力。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Small-parameter models are rapidly outperforming general-purpose LLMs in specific vertical tasks like OCR, underscoring industry preference for specialized inference pipelines. title_en:
Quick clarification on what is/isn't blocked to Megaspeed given its Entity Listing did not include the FDPR, because I've received a number of questions about this and it admittedly gets a little complicated. 

As I noted in my post yesterday, advanced AI chips were already blocked to Megaspeed before this Entity Listing due to the separate, country-wide controls for those chips that Commerce placed on Malaysia, Thailand, Singapore, Indonesia, and Brazil last week. The Megaspeed Entity Listing actually does double-capture these chips, because the new export control rule issued on Monday also modifies U.S. regulations so that the most advanced chips are blocked to any company on the Entity List even if the FDPR is not applied. So those chips are now double-blocked to Megaspeed; the Entity Listing changes nothing on that front. 

However, without the FDPR, a ton of very important AI chips and components made in Taiwan or Korea (with U.S. technology) remain legal to ship to Megaspeed. This includes less advanced AI chips, such as the Nvidia H20 chips (which require a license to ship to China). It includes high-bandwidth memory (which China cannot make at scale and needs to make its own AI chips, and is banned for export to China but is being smuggled into China in large quantities). And it includes networking equipment, server chips, and other items that Megaspeed needs to use the AI chips it already has. 

Now that we know Megaspeed is a Chinese shell company, there is no reason to let Megaspeed continue to legally purchase any AI chips and components that it would either smuggle back to China or use to sustain its data centers in Malaysia. This is exactly why the United States has historically applied the FDPR to all companies it has placed on the Entity List that deal with AI chips, which completely cuts them off from all chips and key chip components made outside the United States (this is also just logical because the Entity Listing bans them from receiving all such goods made INSIDE the United States). But because Megaspeed's listing does not include the FDPR, all of these items remain legal to ship to Megaspeed. 

The fact that Megaspeed, a known Chinese shell company engaged in a massive smuggling operation, is not totally cut off from all AI chips and high-bandwidth memory—which cannot be shipped to China without a license and are known to be smuggled in large quantities—is absurd. 

And one last point on another issue with the package, which I didn't make in my previous post: the listing also does not include any of the China-based nodes of the Alice Huang smuggling network, such as Shanghai Century Litong, which have been identified by multiple news outlets (The Information, NYT, WSJ). Those should obviously be added too, why were they not included? 

By the way, Nvidia's website STILL lists both Megaspeed and Shanghai Century Litong as official "cloud partners."

正如我在昨天的帖子中指出的，由于商务部上周对马来西亚、泰国、新加坡、印度尼西亚和巴西
author: @ChrisRMcGuire
summary_zh:
对这些芯片实施了单独的全国范围内的控制，在此次实体上市之前，先进的人工智能芯片已经被 Megaspeed 屏蔽。 Megaspeed实体清单实际上确实双重捕获了这些芯片，因为周一发布的新出口管制规则还修改了美国法规，使得即使不适用FDPR，实体清单上的任何公司也将无法获得最先进的芯片。因此，这些芯片现在已双阻塞至 Megaspeed；实体清单在这方面没有任何改变。

然而，如果没有 FDPR，台湾或韩国制造的大量非常重要的人工智能芯片和组件（采用美国技术）仍然可以合法运送到 Megaspeed。这包括不太先进的人工智能芯片，例如 Nvidia H20 芯片（需要获得向中国发货的许可证）。其中包括高带宽存储器（中国无法大规模生产，需要制造自己的人工智能芯片，并且被禁止向中国出口，但正在大量走私到中国）。其中包括网络设备、服务器芯片以及 Megaspeed 使用其已有的人工智能芯片所需的其他物品。

既然我们知道 Megaspeed 是一家中国空壳公司，那么就没有理由让 Megaspeed 继续合法购买任何人工智能芯片和组件，这些芯片和组件要么走私回中国，要么用于维持其在马来西亚的数据中心。这正是美国历史上将 FDPR 应用于其列入实体清单的所有处理 AI 芯片的公司的原因，这完全切断了它们与美国境外制造的所有芯片和关键芯片组件的联系（这也是合乎逻辑的，因为实体清单禁止它们接收所有在美国境内制造的此类商品）。但由于 Megaspeed 的清单不包括 FDPR，因此所有这些物品仍然可以合法运送到 Megaspeed。

Megaspeed是一家从事大规模走私活动的知名中国空壳公司，它并没有完全切断所有人工智能芯片和高带宽内存的供应——这些芯片和高带宽内存没有许可证就不能运往中国，而且众所周知是大量走私的——这一事实是荒谬的。

关于该包裹的另一个问题的最后一点，我在上一篇文章中没有提及：该清单也不包括 Alice Huang 走私网络的任何中国节点，例如上海世纪利通，这些节点已被多家新闻媒体（《信息报》、《纽约时报》、《华尔街日报》）确认。这些显然也应该添加，为什么没有包括在内？

顺便说一下，Nvidia 的网站仍然将 Megaspeed 和上海世纪力通列为官方“云合作伙伴”。

title: Some personal updates: I'll join Princeton University as an Associate Professor in the Department of Computer Science in Fall 2027. I'm moving my Robot Perception and Learning Lab to @PrincetonCS, along with my students. And yes, I'm recruiting new PhD
title_en:
Some personal updates:

I'll join Princeton University as an Associate Professor in the Department of Computer Science in Fall 2027. I'm moving my Robot Perception and Learning Lab to @PrincetonCS, along with my students. And yes, I'm recruiting new PhD students and postdocs this cycle!

I'm deeply grateful to my students, colleagues, and collaborators at UT Austin, who have made it a memorable chapter of my life. UT is a great place to build a research career, with tremendous resources, excellent students, and a warmhearted community. I also feel fortunate to have called Austin home for the past six years, as I have witnessed its growth into one of America's most vibrant tech hubs.

Alongside this transition, I'll continue to co-lead the NVIDIA GEAR team, where we push the frontier of general-purpose robot autonomy. I also look forward to connecting with the growing robotics industry on the East Coast and finding new collaboration opportunities.

Needless to say, this move comes at a challenging time for academia.

Rapid AI advances are fundamentally reshaping how knowledge is created, disseminated, and applied. Universities must rethink their roles in a world where frontier AI systems can perform tasks once requiring years of specialized training. Yet, I believe these challenges present universities with a greater mission: to prepare younger generations for the post-AGI era and cultivate human character, values, taste, judgment, and a sense of purpose. The pursuit of truth, driven by intellectual curiosity and academic freedom, remains at the heart of universities.

On the research side, I've seen firsthand how frontier AI development is becoming increasingly resource-intensive and concentrated in well-funded industrial labs (including GEAR itself). At the same time, academia has an enduring responsibility to seek fundamental understanding, ask hard questions whose answers have no immediate commercial payoffs, and advance knowledge for the benefit of humanity and the betterment of society.

I chose Princeton because of its deep commitment to fundamental research and education. I see it as an extraordinary place to tackle these challenges and explore new opportunities. Together with the Princeton community, I hope to help shape the future of higher education.

I'm excited for this next chapter and everything ahead!
title_zh: 学术人才动态：Yuke Zhu教授将入职普林斯顿
author: @yukez
full_text_zh:
一些个人更新：

我将于 2027 年秋季加入普林斯顿大学，担任计算机科学系副教授。我将与我的学生一起将我的机器人感知和学习实验室移至 @PrincetonCS。是的，我这个周期正在招募新的博士生和博士后！

我深深感谢我在德州大学奥斯汀分校的学生、同事和合作者，他们让我的人生成为难忘的篇章。德克萨斯大学是建立研究事业的好地方，拥有丰富的资源、优秀的学生和热情的社区。我也很幸运在过去六年里把奥斯汀称为自己的家，因为我见证了它成长为美国最具活力的科技中心之一。

在这一转变的同时，我将继续共同领导 NVIDIA GEAR 团队，推动通用机器人自主的前沿发展。我也期待与东海岸不断发展的机器人行业建立联系，并寻找新的合作机会。

不用说，此举正值学术界面临挑战的时期。

人工智能的快速发展正在从根本上重塑知识的创造、传播和应用方式。在前沿人工智能系统可以执行曾经需要多年专业培训的任务的世界中，大学必须重新思考自己的角色。然而，我相信这些挑战给大学带来了更伟大的使命：让年轻一代为后通用人工智能时代做好准备，培养人的性格、价值观、品味、判断力和使命感。在求知欲和学术自由的驱动下对真理的追求仍然是大学的核心。

在研究方面，我亲眼目睹了前沿人工智能开发如何变得越来越资源密集型，并集中在资金充足的工业实验室（包括 GEAR 本身）。与此同时，学术界负有持久的责任，寻求基本的理解，提出其答案不会立即产生商业回报的难题，并为了人类的利益和社会的进步而推进知识的发展。

我选择普林斯顿大学是因为它致力于基础研究和教育。我认为这是应对这些挑战和探索新机遇的非凡场所。我希望与普林斯顿社区一起帮助塑造高等教育的未来。

我对下一章和未来的一切感到兴奋！

title: 一代人正在变得丰富。验证是更难的问题。 SenseNova U1.6引入了原生视觉自我校正：它生成信息图，根据原始提示检查渲染的文本，并在不丢弃周围环境的情况下修改错误。
title_en:
Generation is becoming abundant. 

Verification is the harder problem. 

SenseNova U1.6 introduces native visual self-correction: it generates an infographic, checks the rendered text against the original prompt, and revises errors without discarding the surrounding typography or layout. 

That shift from one-shot output to iterative visual reasoning is the part I find most interesting. 

Built on Neo-unify, with native ComfyUI support. 

Source: https://github.com/OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-U1

title: So much of the US social-political contract is 'line must go up' in the stock market, and so much of the stock market now is predicated on 'AI must work.' And AI is intensely politically unpopular. Seems like a big tension.

title: I made a video editor that lets you cut by hand or with AI agents. It's called Editroom. https://t.co/RK0gcM1pYa It's 100% free and open source. I built it for myself since I found iMovie unusable, Resolve too complicated, and Premiere too heavy. the app includes:
title_en:
I made a video editor that lets you cut by hand or with AI agents. It's called Editroom.
http://robbietilton.com/editroom

It's 100% free and open source. I built it for myself since I found iMovie unusable, Resolve too complicated, and Premiere too heavy.

the app includes:
• Color grading + LUTs, with HDR and Log support
• Speed ramps, transitions and fades
• Auto captions, timed word by word
• Search footage by what's said or what's in the shot
• AI editing: on-device, or with Claude and ChatGPT
• Built-in MCP server

Editroom is 23 MB. Premiere is 6.95 GB, Resolve 6.34 GB, and iMovie 4.29 GB

我制作了一个视频编辑器，可以让你手动或使用人工智能代理进行剪辑。它被称为编辑室。
http://robbietilton.com/editroom

它是 100% 免费和开源的。我为自己构建了它，因为我发现 iMovie 无法使用，Resolve 太复杂，Premiere 太重。

该应用程序包括：
• 颜色分级 + LUT，支持 HDR 和 Log
• 速度斜坡、过渡和淡入淡出
• 自动字幕，逐字计时
• 按所说内容或镜头中的内容搜索镜头
• AI 编辑：在设备上或使用 Claude 和 ChatGPT
• 内置MCP服务器

编辑室大小为 23 MB。 Premiere 6.95 GB、Resolve 6.34 GB 和 iMovie 4.29 GB
